test_title: PYST 8: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which letter cluster will replace the question mark (?) to complete the given series?

ECO HFN KIM ? QOK
solution:
Series: ECO, HFN, KIM, ?, QOK

**Alphabet position pattern (+3)**

E C O

H F N

K I M

? ? ?

Q O K

Check 1st letters:

E → H → K → ? → Q

⇒ +3 pattern

E(5) +3 = H(8)

H(8) +3 = K(11)

K(11) +3 = N(14)

N(14) +3 = Q(17)

1st letter = N

Check 2nd letters:

C → F → I → ? → O

⇒ +3 pattern

C(3) +3 = F(6)

F(6) +3 = I(9)

I(9) +3 = L(12)

L(12) +3 = O(15)

2nd letter = L

Check 3rd letters:

O → N → M → ? → K

⇒ −1 pattern

O(15) −1 = N(14)

N(14) −1 = M(13)

M(13) −1 = L(12)

L(12) −1 = K(11)

3rd letter = L

⇒ Missing cluster = NLL

**∴ Required letter cluster = NLL.**

Hence the correct answer is **Option 2.**
